claims: Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) is a public university in Richmond, Virginia.
Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) was founded in 1838.
Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) was established in 1968.
VCU features VCU Health, a major academic health center.
VCU has a student body of over 29,000.
VCU offers over 200 certificate and degree programs.
VCU is ranked among the top 50 public research universities by the National Science Foundation.
VCU Health serves as a major urban academic medical center.
VCU Health includes the VCU Massey Comprehensive Cancer Center.
VCU operates two main campuses, the Monroe Park Campus and the MCV Campus.
The Monroe Park Campus and the MCV Campus are located in downtown Richmond.
VCU teams are called the Rams.
The Rams compete in Division I.
Vehicle Control Unit (VCU) is the main control unit in electric vehicles.
Vehicle Control Unit (VCU) coordinates the powertrain and overall vehicle functions in electric vehicles.
